instrument.citation: By-law 569-2013, as amended, as it read on or prior to July 22, 2022

calculation_handling.description: A project with a complete zoning by-law amendment application filed on or before July 22, 2022 may comply with the listed 970.10.15 regulations or the former text of By-law 569-2013 instead of the listed parking regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Alternate compliance path under a former by-law; never evaluated.

units.disclosure: Projects with a complete zoning by-law amendment application filed on or before July 22, 2022 may follow the earlier parking rules; this alternate path is not evaluated.

instrument.citation: By-law 569-2013, as amended, as it read after July 22, 2022 and on or prior to March 31, 2025

calculation_handling.description: A project with a complete zoning by-law amendment application filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 may comply with the listed 970.10 regulations or the by-law as it read in that period instead of the listed parking regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Alternate compliance path under a former by-law; never evaluated.

units.disclosure: Projects with a complete zoning by-law amendment application filed between July 22, 2022 and March 31, 2025 may follow the earlier parking rules; this alternate path is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a complete application for a zoning by-law amendment as one meeting Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.

200.25.15.2(1).explanation: Transition rule: the listed parking regulations do not stop a project whose complete zoning by-law amendment application was filed on or before July 22, 2022, if it complies with the listed 970.10.15 regulations or with By-law 569-2013 as it read on or before that date.

200.25.15.2(2).explanation: Transition rule: the listed accessible parking regulations do not stop a project whose complete zoning by-law amendment application was filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, if it complies with the listed 970.10 regulations or the by-law as it read in that period.

200.25.15.2(3).explanation: A complete application for a zoning by-law amendment, for this transition, means one that meets City of Toronto Official Plan Policy 5.5.2.
